uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: The user heals an additional 10% of the healing value to allies or themself while that target is at or below 30% HP.
The user whips their vines about in a headbutt, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. This Pokémon has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
The user scatters curious leaves at a designated target, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 40% for 2s.

The user slashes with their vines in the designated direction, stopping at the first target hit, dealing damage and rooting opposing Pokémon for 1s. While in full bloom, the move becomes wider. After hitting an opposing Pokémon, other nearby opposing Pokémon will be targeted, after 2s have passed any targeted Pokémon in range will be hit by this move.
Reduces the cooldown of this move by 1s.

The user photosynthesizes and produces energy around the designated ally and the user for 1s. Allies in the area of effect get healed, if within both circles of energy the second circle's healing is halved, while opposing Pokémon have their damage lowered by 15% for 3s.

The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and slowing them down by 30% for 2s, while an area around the user heals ally Pokémon. While in full bloom, the blizzard travels further and leaves a lingering area for 2s dealing damage every 0.5s up to 4 more times and slowing opposing Pokémon by 40% for 2s instead. The user and ally Pokémon near the user are healed up to 4 more times every 0.5s, additionally walking through the lingering area grants 50% increased movement speed for 2s. Damage and healing beyond the first instance has reduced effectiveness. 15% of the first hit of damage. 5% of the first tick of healing.
Increases the effectiveness of this move's healing. 5% of the first tick of healing.

The user emits a sweet aroma around themselves dealing damage to opposing Pokémon every 0.5s up to 10 times. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move have their damage reduced by 10% for 3s, the duration is refreshed on each hit. For up to 5s, the user's next move will be in full bloom, granting extra effects. Meganium gains 2700 energy per second instead of the usual 900. Hitting with moves grants 4500 energy.
Buffs: 10% Movement Speed, 10% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 5
